verdict.rationale: Floot's only programmatic surface is a first-party remote MCP server. Its tools cover substantial UI functionality: logs, database reads, writes and schema, checkpoints, image generation, and building and shipping apps "without leaving your AI chat." Parity is not complete, though: API keys must be typed into a browser dialog on floot.com, and there is no REST API or OpenAPI document. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API (REST or OpenAPI), an explicit UI-to-API parity mapping, evidence that custom domains, sharing and collaborators, mobile app conversion, and secret entry work without the UI, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It lets you build and ship full-stack apps without leaving your AI chat — works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more
query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.
